title: TEHRAN — 19 October 2026
text:
TEHRAN — 19 October 2026"

"Major General Rezaei: Regional stability depends on multilateral cooperation"

"The Secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council, Major General Rezaei, in a meeting with Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov:"

"· We emphasize strategic cooperation between the two countries on intra-regional issues in order to consolidate stability, ensure regional security, and accelerate development and progress in the countries of the region."
"· We welcome Russia’s ideas and initiatives for expanding diverse cooperation between the two countries."
"· Joint economic projects between Iran and Russia, such as the completion of strategic corridors, have regionally stabilizing effects."
"· The continuation and durability of security and stability in the region depend on multilateral cooperation within the region."

"Source:  Office of the Supreme National Security Council of Iran
